title: DCP Bell Conjugate-Pair Phase Cancellation Obstruction
claims: Bell measurement on rho(a_1, s) tensor rho(a_2, s) samples sum-header cosine on Phi^pm and difference-header cosine on Psi^pm with attenuated coherence gamma_1 * gamma_2.
All four Bell outcome probabilities are invariant under s -> -s mod q.
Includes the matched-header swap-test control a_1 == a_2 where P(Psi^+) = (1 + gamma^2)/4 is secret-independent.

For IID uniform random headers and fixed known coherence, one random-header X observation and public randomness reproduce the complete Bell transcript using synthetic headers; no chosen-header query is needed.
This does not simulate prespecified or selected header pairs, retained quantum outputs, header-dependent noise or extra correlated side information, and is not a classical DCP solver.
